clean.help:
usage: clowder clean [-h] [--recursive] [--all] [--untracked-directories]
                     [--force] [--ignored] [--untracked-files] [--submodules]
                     [<project|group> ...]

positional arguments:
  <project|group>       projects and groups to clean

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --recursive, -r       clean submodules recursively

clean options:
  --all, -a             clean all the things
  --untracked-directories, -d
                        remove untracked directories
  --force, -f           remove directories with .git subdirectory or file
  --ignored, -X         remove only files ignored by git
  --untracked-files, -x
                        remove all untracked files
  --submodules, -s      clean submodules

herd.help:
usage: clowder herd [-h] [--jobs <n>] [--rebase] [--depth <n>]
                    [--protocol <protocol>]
                    [--exclude <exclude> [<exclude> ...]]
                    [--branch <branch> | --tag <tag>]
                    [<project|group> ...]

positional arguments:
  <project|group>       projects and groups to herd

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --jobs <n>, -j <n>    number of jobs to use running command in parallel
  --rebase, -r          use rebase instead of pull
  --depth <n>, -d <n>   depth to herd
  --protocol <protocol>, -p <protocol>
                        git protocol to use for cloning
  --exclude <exclude> [<exclude> ...]
                        Projects to exclude
  --branch <branch>, -b <branch>
                        branch to herd if present
  --tag <tag>, -t <tag>
                        tag to herd if present

help:
usage: clowder [-h] [-v] [--debug]
               {branch,checkout,clean,config,diff,forall,herd,init,link,prune,repo,reset,save,start,stash,status,yaml}
               ...

positional arguments:
  {branch,checkout,clean,config,diff,forall,herd,init,link,prune,repo,reset,save,start,stash,status,yaml}
    branch              Display current branches
    checkout            Checkout local branch in projects
    clean               Discard current changes in projects
    config              Manage clowder config (EXPERIMENTAL)
    diff                Show git diff for projects
    forall              Run command or script in project directories
    herd                Clone and update projects with latest changes
    init                Clone repository to clowder directory and create
                        clowder yaml symlink
    link                Symlink clowder yaml version
    prune               Prune branches
    repo                Manage clowder repo
    reset               Reset branches to upstream commits or check out
                        detached HEADs for tags and shas
    save                Create clowder yaml version for current repos
    start               Start a new branch
    stash               Stash current changes
    status              projects and groups to print status of
    yaml                Print clowder yaml file information

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  -v, --version         show program's version number and exit
  --debug, -d           print debug output
